results.title: Costa Rica Tourism Drivers Protest Possible Airport Access for Ride-Hailing Apps
results.description: Tourism transportation operators plan to demonstrate outside Casa Presidencial tomorrow over a possible change to legislation that could allow Uber-type ride-hailing services to operate at Costa Rica’s airports.
